name: Pie Crust
time: ~2 hr 45 min, ~35 min hands-on (mostly chilling; estimated)

items: 6 Tablespoons (90g) unsalted butter, chilled and cubed

steps.title: Cut in the shortening
steps.body: For the shortening crust, cut together til in pea-sized chunks: **2⅔ cups flour**, **1 tsp salt** and **⅞ cup shortening or lard**.

steps.title: Mix in water
steps.body: For the shortening crust, mix in gently til just moist: **½ cup + cold water**.

steps.title: Chill the dough
steps.body: Chill for two hours before rolling out.

steps.title: Roll and bake
steps.body: Roll out on pastry cloth and place in pie pans. For unfilled baking, prick with fork and bake at 425°F for about 10 minutes. If filled, follow pie instructions for baking.

steps.title: Bake cookies
steps.body: Make sugar and cinnamon cookies out of leftover dough, and bake at 425°F for 10 minutes.
